feedback_text: Opening the billing screen takes long enough that agents sometimes refresh the page.
The workflow editor is powerful, but new automations are difficult to configure without documentation.
I would like a night theme for late evening work.
Our checkout-related automation occasionally pauses for 20–30 seconds before completing.
The weekly activity digest is useful, but it contains too much detail for managers.
Billing pages still feel sluggish, especially when loading invoices from last year.
Please add dark mode. The white interface is uncomfortable during evening review sessions.
We can build the workflow, but it is hard to tell which step failed after a run times out.
The payment notification workflow completed faster this month; we have not seen the long pause recently.
A CSV export from reports produced duplicate rows once. We could not reproduce it.
Checkout automation is still taking several seconds to trigger when traffic is high.
Dark mode would make dashboard reviews much easier for our team.
Invoice search is better than before, although the first billing-page load remains slow.
The activity digest is now much easier to scan after the recent formatting changes.
Our order-confirmation workflow occasionally waits before it starts. It is less frequent, but it has not disappeared.
We need a darker color scheme for the dashboard and workflow editor.
The checkout trigger delay happened again during our Monday peak.
Workflow setup feels easier now that failed steps show more useful messages.
Dark mode is becoming important for our distributed team; several people have asked for it.
The checkout workflow is quicker than it was in January, but peak-time delays still affect some orders.
